figures.caption: Fig. 1: Qualitative Failure Analysis of SOTA VLMs on Video Emotion Recognition. VLMs like Gemini2.5-Flash, Qwen2.5-VL and EmotionQwen misclassify emotions by failing to capture subtle, temporal cues. Examples include overlooking a brief smile (top row, ‘Happiness’ misclassified as ‘Sadness/Neutral/Disgust’) or a tensed facial expression (bottom row, ‘Anger’ misclassified as ‘Neutral/Anxiety’)
